sql: WITH c AS (SELECT date(insert_date) dt,city_name,row_number() over(partition by date(insert_date) order by city_id,city_name) rn FROM cities WHERE country_code_2='cn' AND insert_date >= '2021-07-01' AND insert_date < '2021-08-01'), d AS (SELECT dt,city_name,julianday(dt)-row_number() over(order by dt) island FROM c WHERE rn=1), s AS (SELECT island,count(*) days FROM d GROUP BY island) SELECT d.dt AS date,upper(substr(city_name,1,1))||lower(substr(city_name,2)) AS city_name FROM d JOIN s USING(island) WHERE days=(SELECT min(days) FROM s) OR days=(SELECT max(days) FROM s) ORDER BY date
